games.name: StarRupture

metacritic.note: Provisional score from GameSpace, full Metascore pending additional reviews

games.description: StarRupture is a first-person open world base-building game with advanced combat and tons of exploration. Play alone or in a group on this sublime and ever-changing planet, extract and manage resources, create your complex industrial system and fight off hordes of alien monsters.

price.note: Early Access pricing, may increase on full release

games.whyInterested: Matches preferences for survival crafting games, base building, open world exploration, and automation systems. Similar to Satisfactory and Factorio with survival elements. Supports up to 4-player co-op. From developers of Green Hell.
games.notes: Early Access game, planned to stay in Early Access for about a year. Features complex industrial automation systems with outdoor machines and assembly lines. Set on alien planet Arcadia-7. Includes survival elements, resource extraction, and base defense against alien creatures. Reached nearly 28,000 concurrent players at launch.
